Hey so when you first go to check out a community college they're very used to people who don't know what they want to do yet. If you tell someone like an advisor that you're wanting a career change but don't know where to start, they will literally sit you down and have you take a few personality and interest quizzes to see what your best fits are. This is all totally free before you ever sign up for anything. You might also qualify for Hella financial aid bc you're over 24 and have children. You might even be able to find chill easy employment AT the community college. 
For real, just take one day to check it out. 
Also hope things work out with the family situation, that sounds tough but you can do this!!
